narrative.body1: Breakpoint 2026 centers on the Token Supercycle: a new era in which stablecoins, tokenized assets, payments, and AI-driven economic activity increasingly move onchain. As AI accelerates demand for capital, coordination, and real-time settlement, Solana is the battle-tested, always-on infrastructure built for the next generation of the global economy.
narrative.body2: Breakpoint 2026 brings together financial institutions, technology companies, investors, and policymakers shaping this supercycle and building the next era of capital markets.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.metadataDescription: Answers to common Breakpoint 2026 questions about the event, tickets, travel, and attending in London.

items.question: Where is Breakpoint located this year?
items.answer: Breakpoint 2026 will take place at Olympia Convention Centre in London.

items.question: How can I apply to speak at Breakpoint?
How can I sponsor Breakpoint?
items.answer: If you're interested in sponsoring Breakpoint, submit your details

items.question: How can I apply for press or content creator access?
items.answer: Use the Press or Content Creator application in the Get Involved section on the homepage.

items.question: Who do I contact with questions?
items.answer: Email breakpoint@solana.org and the team will route your question to the right person.

items.question: What is included in my Breakpoint ticket?
items.answer: Your ticket includes access to main conference programming, networking areas, and on-site experiences. Food and beverages will be available on-site, along with Breakpoint merch.

items.question: Are tickets refundable?
items.answer: Tickets are non-refundable but are transferable.

items.question: Are developer and student tickets available?
items.answer: Yes. Developers and students can apply for discounted Breakpoint tickets through the registration page.

items.question: When do ticket prices change?
items.answer: Ticket prices increase on a rolling basis as we approach the event. We recommend purchasing early for the best rates.

items.question: Can I transfer my ticket?
items.answer: Yes. If you purchased through Lu.ma, use the transfer tools in your ticket confirmation to
items.answerLinkLabel: assign the ticket to another attendee

items.question: Do I need a ticket for side events?
items.answer: Some side events require a separate RSVP. Check the event listing before attending, even if you already have a Breakpoint ticket.

items.question: Can children attend Breakpoint?
items.answer: Children 16 and under are welcome to attend Breakpoint when accompanied by a registered parent or legal guardian. At registration, an adult must sign a waiver for each child to enter the venue. Parents and guardians are responsible for supervising their children at all times. Breakpoint does not provide childcare, and access to certain areas may be restricted.

items.question: Which airport should I fly into?
items.answer: London City, Heathrow, and Gatwick all connect to Olympia by public transport, taxi, or rideshare. Choose the route that works best for your arrival city.

items.question: Are hotel recommendations available?
items.answer: Yes. The travel page lists hotel recommendations with approximate travel times to Olympia Convention Centre.

items.question: Do I need a visa to attend?
items.answer: Entry requirements depend on your passport and travel plans. Review the official UK visa checker before booking travel.

items.question: How do I request an invitation letter?
How do I get to Olympia Convention Centre?
items.answer: Olympia is connected by London public transport and is also reachable by taxi or rideshare from central London.

items.question: Can Solana Foundation help with visas?
items.answer: Attendees are responsible for their own visa process. Solana Foundation has engaged Immigration Advice Service for attendees who need paid visa support.

institutional.title: The institutional turn
institutional.body: Last year, J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, BlackRock, State Street, and Citigroup all deployed production capital on Solana. At Breakpoint, the teams behind these integrations share what's next - and what they need from builders.
institutional.imageAlt: Breakpoint attendees watching a main stage presentation

infrastructure.title: The infrastructure leap
infrastructure.body: Alpenglow. Firedancer. P-Token. Constellation. The Solana network is shipping the most significant upgrades in its history. Hear directly from the engineers building the consensus and execution layers that will power global finance.
infrastructure.imageAlt: Breakpoint attendees talking with a Solana ecosystem team

builders.title: The builder economy
builders.body: 75+ products launched at Breakpoint 2025. From agentic commerce, consumer applications, and digital collectibles to tokenized equities, AI agents, stablecoin payroll, and machine-to-machine payments - Breakpoint is where the Solana ecosystem ships. This year, it ships in London.
